item: R795 (row 330, row 337): a backup passphrase is named wrong only on this installation's own signed list
summary: the early passphrase check names a passphrase wrong only when the first volume matches a list of volumes signed, validly, by this installation's own key (signing_key_state, which never creates a key); an unsigned list, a bad signature, another installation's key or an unreadable own key is still refused, as before, but as 'could not check the passphrase' with that reason, so a volume swapped and re-signed with another key (the three-step swap) never makes the right passphrase read as wrong; backup_passphrase_check is tri-state and the import queue refuses one sentence per line; 'intact' is gone from both refusals; ooServerText translates them and the row 312/329 crypto refusals whole in all 12 languages (row 337); no acceptance rule changed.
